content:
AIIMS NORCET 11th Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 – Notification Out | Apply Now

  • Start Date : 24 July 2026
  • Last Date : 13 August 2026
  • Post : Nursing Officer (NORCET-11)
  • Status : Notification Out – Link Active

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi has released the notification and started online registration for NORCET-11 (Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test).

Eligible candidates can Apply Now from 24 July 2026 to 13 August 2026 (5:00 PM) for Nursing Officer posts (Level-7) across AIIMS and participating institutes. Tentative vacancies: about 2218 (confirm seat matrix in official notice).

Important Dates

  • Notification / Registration Start : 24 July 2026
  • Last Date to Apply : 13 August 2026 (5:00 PM)
  • Stage-I Exam (Prelim) : about 12 September 2026 (tentative)
  • Stage-II Exam (Mains) : about 30 September 2026 (tentative)
  • Admit Card : Before CBT

Eligibility (summary)

  • B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / GNM with registration as per NORCET rules
  • Age generally 18–30 years with relaxations
  • Experience criteria if mentioned for any category in notification

Selection Process

Stage-I (Preliminary CBT) → Stage-II (Mains CBT) → Eligibility List → Institute allocation / Document Verification.

How to Apply (Apply Now)

  1. Open https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in
  2. Click NORCET-11 registration / Apply Online
  3. New Registration → fill details → upload documents → pay fee
  4. Submit before 13 August 2026
  5. Keep confirmation page printout

Apply only on official AIIMS exams portal. Read full NORCET-11 notification before applying.
